screen.reason: The paper develops and benchmarks a new agentic LLM diagnostic reasoning framework (DxChain) using retrospective EHR datasets (MIMIC-IV extensions). It evaluates diagnostic accuracy and consistency of the proposed architecture rather than a health system deployment practice or guardrail.
